run_distributed_training: run the multiprocessing helper to execute a function across multiple GPU processes with distributed training
run_multi_process_func: run a function from child processes using torch distributed with configurable backend and shard configuration
run_cuda_distributed_job: run a CUDA-enabled distributed job by initializing process groups and setting local GPU device per process
run_sharded_distributed_task: run a sharded distributed task across multiple machines with TCP or shared-file-system initialization
run_collective_process_group: run collective process group execution with output queue support for returning results from the master process
